text.tspan: import brings an object IN; taint / -replace REBUILDS an object already in
terraform import: adopt something that already exists
import = add to state, no infra change. taint = mark in state, rebuild on the NEXT apply (hidden, affects everyone).
-replace = rebuild in THIS plan only, shown in the plan, state untouched until apply. taint deprecated since v0.15.2; still works in 1.13.
